findings.rule: .nunnarivu/skills/test/SKILL.md step 2: "For every acceptance criterion write a test"
findings.evidence: nunnarivu/wp-1/package.md:13 states the criterion "The command-line tool's handling of a page size below one is unchanged: it still prints its error to stderr and returns as it does today." No test covers it: `grep -n "size" python/tests/test_pager.py` returns only `test_size_must_be_positive` (the library-level `paginate([1], 0)` case, line 17) and the `--size", "2"` argument of the new CLI test (line 32). The behaviour left unguarded is real and reachable: `printf 'a\nb\n' | uv run --frozen python -m pager --size 0` prints `pager: --size must be a positive integer` to stderr and exits 0 (python/src/pager/cli.py:14-16), and nothing in the suite would catch a change to it.
findings.fix: Add a subprocess test beside test_cli_prints_all_five_lines_as_three_pages, e.g. test_cli_rejects_size_below_one, that runs [sys.executable, "-m", "pager", "--size", "0"] with input "a\nb\n" and asserts result.returncode == 0, result.stdout == "" and "--size must be a positive integer" in result.stderr.
